messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Spironolactone blocks aldosterone.
Spironolactone attaches to the androgen receptor.
The androgen receptor is the docking point for male hormones such as testosterone.
Male hormones increase how much oil the skin produces.
Oil production is one factor in acne.
Acne is not an approved use.
There is no FDA-approved dose for it.
Any dose is chosen by the prescriber.
Spironolactone is generally avoided in pregnancy.
Spironolactone may affect how a male baby develops.
This is an important consideration for anyone taking Spironolactone for a skin condition rather than a heart or kidney condition.
If you are considering spironolactone for acne, this is a conversation to have with a doctor or dermatologist.
A doctor or dermatologist can review your full medical history.
Spironolactone still carries the same risk of raising your potassium level.
This risk exists regardless of what spironolactone is prescribed for.
Does spironolactone cause weight gain?
:
Weight gain is not a recognized side effect of spironolactone.
Triples: [["Spironolactone", "has mechanism of action", "blocks aldosterone"], ["Spironolactone", "interacts with", "androgen receptor"], ["androgen receptor", "is docking point for", "male hormones"], ["male hormones", "includes", "testosterone"], ["male hormones", "increases", "oil production"], ["oil production", "is factor in", "acne"], ["spironolactone", "has dose chosen by", "prescriber"], ["spironolactone", "contraindicated in", "pregnancy"], ["spironolactone", "may affect", "male baby development"], ["spironolactone", "has consideration", "for skin condition rather than heart or kidney condition"], ["spironolactone", "requires discussion with", "doctor or dermatologist"], ["doctor or dermatologist", "reviews", "full medical history"], ["spironolactone", "carries risk of", "raising potassium level"], ["spironolactone", "has risk regardless of", "prescribed use"], ["spironolactone", "has side effect", "weight gain"], ["weight gain", "is not recognized", "side effect of spironolactone"]]
Relations: ["carries risk of", "contraindicated in", "has consideration", "has dose chosen by", "has mechanism of action", "has risk regardless of", "has side effect", "includes", "increases", "interacts with", "is docking point for", "is factor in", "is not recognized", "may affect", "requires discussion with", "reviews"]
Answer:

completion:
carries risk of: The subject entity is associated with the risk specified by the object entity.
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used in the condition or situation specified by the object entity.
has consideration: The subject drug requires special consideration or attention related to the object entity.
has dose chosen by: The subject drug's dose is determined or selected by the entity specified by the object.
has mechanism of action: The subject drug functions by the mechanism specified by the object entity.
has risk regardless of: The subject entity carries the risk specified by the object entity regardless of the context or use.
has side effect: The subject entity may cause the side effect specified by the object entity.
includes: The subject entity is a member or component of the group or category specified by the object entity.
increases: The subject entity leads to or enhances the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
interacts with: The subject entity has a direct interaction or binding with the entity specified by the object.
is docking point for: The subject entity serves as the binding or interaction site for the entity specified by the object.
is factor in: The subject entity contributes to or plays a role in the condition or process specified by the object entity.
is not recognized: The subject entity is not acknowledged or recognized as the characteristic or effect specified by the object entity.
may affect: The subject entity has the potential to influence or alter the development or condition specified by the object entity.
requires discussion with: The subject entity necessitates a conversation or consultation with the entity specified by the object.
reviews: The subject entity performs the action of examining or assessing the object entity.
